summary: Added Asana OAuth setup and fetch scripts for firewall-dashboard
details:
Created scripts/asana-oauth-setup.js (local OAuth on port 8845, CSRF state validation, token upsert to .env without logging secrets), scripts/fetch-asana.js (refresh token flow, paginated project tasks, maps to FirewallTask shape for the React app), and scripts/asana-env.js (shared .env load/upsert). Updated .env.example for OAuth vars and ASANA_PROJECT_GID default. Added npm run setup-oauth. Output writes to public/data/tasks.json.

User action: copy .env.example to .env, add ASANA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, run npm run setup-oauth then npm run fetch.
issues: Live OAuth/fetch not run in agent environment (no .env credentials). User must complete browser auth locally.
